title: Glowing Tandoori Smoke Chicken
description: A fusion of Indian and futuristic flavors, this dish combines smoky spices with glowing undertones.

ingredients.name: Glowing turmeric
ingredients.notes: You can make this by mixing turmeric with a small amount of glow powder

instructions: 1. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a bowl, mix together tandoori masala, smoked paprika, glowing turmeric, lime juice, ghee or oil, and salt.
3. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
6. Note: Make sure to handle the glowing turmeric carefully as it can be hazardous if ingested in large quantities.
